lines.text: A collapsed building with exposed rebar and debris, two workers in safety gear (one in a white helmet, one in a green vest) on ladders, and tangled power lines overhead. The scene is illuminated by artificial lighting, suggesting nighttime. The structure's remnants include twisted metal beams and scattered bricks, indicating a recent disaster. A submerged vehicle is visible in the background, partially obscured by rubble.

A submerged vehicle is visible in the background, partially obscured by rubble. A black Toyota Corolla with license plate '152-406' is partially submerged in debris, with its front end elevated over a large crack in the pavement. A man in a maroon shirt and white sneakers stands nearby, observing the vehicle. A police officer in a black uniform with 'POLICIA FEDERAL' on the back raises his hand, possibly directing traffic or assessing the situation. Another worker in a high-visibility vest is present, examining the area.
